column3: One event per logical connection the application releases, from SQLAlchemy's pool checkout and checkin (SqlTraceRecorder.checkoutConnection and releaseConnection, ConnectionPayload.java), also while the SQL Trace panel is paused, never for sharpit's own work, offered with the request id and thread current at checkout whichever thread releases it, a second release ignored, and only while the journal records connection (otherwise no pool listener runs and nothing is counted, as BootUI's checkoutConnection returns null); durationNanos is the held time, failedOrSlow is held at least the slow-query threshold, checkoutNanos is perf_counter_ns at checkout (the sql events' clock); not ported: the RuntimeEvent fields executionId and threadKind; deviation: waitNanos is always 0 (SQLAlchemy has no event for when the request for a connection began, and BootUI's readers treat 0 as no wait, so a wait is never invented); dataSource is the connection-pools panel's display name for the engine (never the URL or password), null for an engine the registry does not hold; the source counts as recorded only while the pool listener runs for the install; deviation: a pool that hands one record to several concurrent checkouts (StaticPool, SingletonThreadPool) journals one event for them, the last one's
